1	# tools/ask.exs — the capture pipeline.
2	#
3	#   elixir tools/ask.exs <slug|YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md> "<prompt>"
4	#
5	# One operator action in, one schema-complete exchange out, plus its
6	# sidecar. Division of labor per docs/exchange-schema.md: envelope fields
7	# are machine-harvested (never model-written); tags/deps are model-
8	# proposed and tool-validated; bodies are verbatim; the operator reads
9	# the file (the audit) and commits (the ratification). This tool never
10	# runs git.
11	#
12	# Env knobs:
13	#   ASK_MODEL            model for the answer call (default: CLI default)
14	#   ASK_CLASSIFY_MODEL   model for the classifier call (default: haiku)
15	#   ASK_K                retriever top-k full-text candidates (default 4)
16	#   ASK_STUB             canned answer envelope file (skips live call 1)
17	#   ASK_STUB_CLASSIFY    canned classifier envelope file (skips call 2)
18	#
19	# T6 note (docs/tripwires.md): this file exceeds one screen deliberately.
20	# Capture is one job with one seam (the backend adapter); splitting the
21	# pipeline would put the schema's single writer in two places.
22	#
23	# #agent-authored — provenance: exchanges/2026-08-15-bootstrap-thread.md
24	
25	defmodule IJS.Util do
26	  def die(msg) do
27	    IO.puts(:stderr, "ask: " <> msg)
28	    System.halt(1)
29	  end
30	
31	  def tmp(tag) do
32	    Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "ijs-#{tag}-#{:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])}")
33	  end
34	
35	  def need!(exe) do
36	    System.find_executable(exe) || die("required executable not found: #{exe}")
37	  end
38	end
39	
40	defmodule IJS.JQ do
41	  import IJS.Util
42	
43	  def valid?(file) do
44	    match?({_, 0}, System.cmd("jq", ["-e", ".", file], stderr_to_stdout: true))
45	  end
46	
47	  # jq -r over a file; nil when jq fails or the value is empty/null.
48	  def raw(file, filter) do
49	    case System.cmd("jq", ["-r", filter, file], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
50	      {out, 0} ->
51	        case String.trim(out) do
52	          "" -> nil
53	          "null" -> nil
54	          s -> s
55	        end
56	
57	      _ ->
58	        nil
59	    end
60	  end
61	
62	  def lines(file, filter) do
63	    case raw(file, filter) do
64	      nil -> []
65	      s -> s |> String.split("\n") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1) |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
66	    end
67	  end
68	
69	  def build_sidecar(answer_env, classify_env, shown_path, out_path) do
70	    base = ["-n", "--slurpfile", "answer", answer_env, "--rawfile", "shown", shown_path]
71	
72	    {args, prog} =
73	      if classify_env && valid?(classify_env) do
74	        {base ++ ["--slurpfile", "classify", classify_env],
75	         "{answer_envelope: $answer[0], classifier_envelope: $classify[0], shown_list: ($shown | split(\"\\n\") | map(select(length>0)))}"}
76	      else
77	        {base,
78	         "{answer_envelope: $answer[0], classifier_envelope: null, shown_list: ($shown | split(\"\\n\") | map(select(length>0)))}"}
79	      end
80	
81	    case System.cmd("jq", args ++ [prog], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
82	      {out, 0} -> File.write!(out_path, out)
83	      {err, _} -> IJS.Util.die("sidecar assembly failed: #{String.slice(err, 0, 200)}")
84	    end
85	  end
86	end

88	defmodule IJS.Backend do
89	  # Backend contract (docs/backend-contract.md): (prompt, opts) -> raw
90	  # envelope on disk. No tools are ever enabled on the call. Adapter #1
91	  # is claude -p; the stub adapter reads a canned envelope from a file.
92	  import IJS.Util
93	
94	  def ask(prompt, opts) do
95	    case opts[:stub] do
96	      nil -> claude_p(prompt, opts)
97	      stub_file -> stub(stub_file)
98	    end
99	  end
100	
101	  defp stub(stub_file) do
102	    File.exists?(stub_file) || die("stub envelope not found: #{stub_file}")
103	    path = tmp("envelope")
104	    File.cp!(stub_file, path)
105	    {:ok, path}
106	  end
107	
108	  defp claude_p(prompt, opts) do
109	    need!("claude")
110	
111	    # Vendor-specific defaults live here, in the adapter: classifier
112	    # calls default to the cheap tier when no model is requested.
113	    model = opts[:model] || if opts[:role] == :classifier, do: "haiku", else: nil
114	
115	    args =
116	      ["-p", "--output-format", "json", "--verbose"] ++
117	        case model do
118	          nil -> []
119	          m -> ["--model", m]
120	        end ++ [prompt]
121	
122	    # claude exits nonzero on error results but still emits the envelope
123	    # on stdout; we inspect the envelope rather than the exit code.
124	    {out, _code} = System.cmd("claude", args, stderr_to_stdout: false)
125	    path = tmp("envelope")
126	    File.write!(path, out)
127	    if String.trim(out) == "", do: {:error, "backend produced no output"}, else: {:ok, path}
128	  end
129	end

131	defmodule IJS.Envelope do
132	  # Shape-proof harvest: `-p --output-format json` emits one object,
133	  # adding --verbose emits an array of messages; both normalize first.
134	  @norm "[if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end]"
135	
136	  defp q(file, tail), do: IJS.JQ.raw(file, @norm <> " | " <> tail)
137	
138	  def harvest(file) do
139	    %{
140	      result: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].result // empty"),
141	      is_error: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].is_error // false"),
142	      session_id:
143	        q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].session_id // empty") ||
144	          q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].session_id // empty"),
145	      model:
146	        q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].model // empty") ||
147	          q(file, "(map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].modelUsage // {}) | keys | .[0] // empty"),
148	      cwd: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].cwd // empty"),
149	      cost: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].total_cost_usd // empty"),
150	      num_turns: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].num_turns // empty"),
151	      denials: q(file, "(map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].permission_denials // []) | length"),
152	      tools:
153	        q(
154	          file,
155	          "[.[] | select(.type==\"assistant\") | .message.content[]? | select(.type==\"tool_use\") | .name] | join(\", \")"
156	        )
157	    }
158	  end
159	end

161	defmodule IJS.Ledger do
162	  def files(exclude \\ nil) do
163	    Path.wildcard("exchanges/*.md")
164	    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == exclude))
165	    |> Enum.sort()
166	  end
167	
168	  def frontmatter_value(file, key) do
169	    file
170	    |> File.read!()
171	    |> String.split("\n")
172	    |> Enum.find_value(fn line ->
173	      case String.split(line, ":", parts: 2) do
174	        [^key, v] -> String.trim(v)
175	        _ -> nil
176	      end
177	    end)
178	  end
179	
180	  def first_prompt_line(file) do
181	    lines = file |> File.read!() |> String.split("\n")
182	    idx = Enum.find_index(lines, &(&1 == "## Prompt"))
183	
184	    if idx do
185	      lines
186	      |> Enum.drop(idx + 1)
187	      |> Enum.take_while(&(!String.starts_with?(&1, "## ")))
188	      |> Enum.find("", fn l ->
189	        t = String.trim(l)
190	        t != "" && !String.starts_with?(t, "#")
191	      end)
192	      |> String.trim()
193	    else
194	      ""
195	    end
196	  end
197	end

199	defmodule IJS.Retriever do
200	  @stop ~w(the a an and or but of to in on for with is are was were be been being it its this that these those as at by from into over under about you your i we they he she them his her our what which who whom how why when where do does did done not no yes if then else so than too very just can could should would may might must will shall have has had having there here also)
201	
202	  def tokens(text) do
203	    text
204	    |> String.downcase()
205	    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9\s-]/, " ")
206	    |> String.split()
207	    |> Enum.reject(&(String.length(&1) < 3 || &1 in @stop))
208	    |> MapSet.new()
209	  end
210	
211	  # Deterministic pre-sort: shared-token count, ties by recency (name desc).
212	  def rank(query_text, candidate_files, k) do
213	    q = tokens(query_text)
214	
215	    scored =
216	      candidate_files
217	      |> Enum.map(fn f -> {f, MapSet.size(MapSet.intersection(q, tokens(File.read!(f))))} end)
218	
219	    top =
220	      scored
221	      |> Enum.filter(fn {_, s} -> s > 0 end)
222	      |> Enum.sort_by(fn {f, s} -> {-s, f} end)
223	      |> Enum.take(k)
224	
225	    {top, scored}
226	  end
227	end

229	defmodule IJS.Classifier do
230	  def vocab do
231	    tax =
232	      Path.wildcard("taxonomy/**")
233	      |> Enum.filter(&File.dir?/1)
234	      |> Enum.map(&String.replace_prefix(&1, "taxonomy/", ""))
235	      |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == "taxonomy"))
236	
237	    used =
238	      IJS.Ledger.files()
239	      |> Enum.flat_map(fn f ->
240	        case IJS.Ledger.frontmatter_value(f, "tags") do
241	          nil -> []
242	          v -> v |> String.split(",") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
243	        end
244	      end)
245	
246	    (tax ++ used) |> Enum.reject(&(&1 in ["", "UNCLASSIFIED"])) |> Enum.uniq() |> Enum.sort()
247	  end
248	
249	  def build_prompt(question, answer, vocab, top, all_scored, target) do
250	    stub_lines =
251	      all_scored
252	      |> Enum.map(fn {f, _} ->
253	        "#{f} | tags: #{IJS.Ledger.frontmatter_value(f, "tags") || "none"} | prompt: #{IJS.Ledger.first_prompt_line(f)}"
254	      end)
255	
256	    full_texts =
257	      top
258	      |> Enum.map(fn {f, score} ->
259	        "----- CANDIDATE (full text, score #{score}): #{f} -----\n" <>
260	          String.slice(File.read!(f), 0, 3000)
261	      end)
262	
263	    """
264	    You are the classification step of an exchange-capture pipeline.
265	    Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no code fences, no prose:
266	    {"tags": ["<taxonomy path>", ...], "deps": ["<repo-relative path>", ...], "reason": "<one sentence>"}
267	    Rules:
268	    - tags: 1 to 3 entries. Prefer EXISTING TAGS verbatim; only if none fits, coin a new lowercase slash-path in the same style.
269	    - deps: zero or more paths chosen ONLY from the candidate exchanges listed below — prior exchanges the new one directly continues. Never invent a path. Never include #{target}.
270	    - reason: one sentence justifying both.
271	
272	    EXISTING TAGS:
273	    #{Enum.join(vocab, "\n")}
274	
275	    CANDIDATE EXCHANGES (every existing exchange, one line each):
276	    #{if stub_lines == [], do: "none", else: Enum.join(stub_lines, "\n")}
277	
278	    TOP CANDIDATES (full text):
279	    #{if full_texts == [], do: "none", else: Enum.join(full_texts, "\n\n")}
280	
281	    NEW EXCHANGE PROMPT:
282	    #{String.slice(question, 0, 600)}
283	
284	    NEW EXCHANGE RESPONSE (may be truncated):
285	    #{String.slice(answer, 0, 2000)}
286	    """
287	  end
288	
289	  # -> %{tags:, new_tags:, deps:, dropped:, reason:, cost:, env: path|nil, unusable: bool}
290	  def run(prompt, vocab, target) do
291	    opts = %{
292	      stub: System.get_env("ASK_STUB_CLASSIFY"),
293	      model: System.get_env("ASK_CLASSIFY_MODEL"),
294	      role: :classifier
295	    }
296	
297	    empty = %{tags: [], new_tags: [], deps: [], dropped: [], reason: nil, cost: nil, cmodel: nil, env: nil, unusable: true}
298	
299	    case IJS.Backend.ask(prompt, opts) do
300	      {:error, _} ->
301	        empty
302	
303	      {:ok, env} ->
304	        h = IJS.Envelope.harvest(env)
305	        text = h.result
306	        cost = h.cost
307	        cmodel = h.model
308	
309	        parsed = parse(text)
310	
311	        case parsed do
312	          nil ->
313	            %{empty | cost: cost, cmodel: cmodel, env: env}
314	
315	          file ->
316	            tags = IJS.JQ.lines(file, "(.tags // []) | if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end")
317	            deps = IJS.JQ.lines(file, "(.deps // []) | if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end")
318	            reason = IJS.JQ.raw(file, ".reason // empty")
319	
320	            valid_tags =
321	              tags
322	              |> Enum.filter(&Regex.match?(~r{^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$}, &1))
323	              |> Enum.take(3)
324	
325	            new_tags = Enum.reject(valid_tags, &(&1 in vocab))
326	
327	            {kept, dropped} =
328	              Enum.split_with(deps, fn d ->
329	                String.starts_with?(d, "exchanges/") && File.exists?(d) && d != target
330	              end)
331	
332	            %{
333	              tags: valid_tags,
334	              new_tags: new_tags,
335	              deps: kept,
336	              dropped: dropped,
337	              reason: reason,
338	              cost: cost,
339	              cmodel: cmodel,
340	              env: env,
341	              unusable: valid_tags == []
342	            }
343	        end
344	    end
345	  end
346	
347	  # Strip fence lines (models fence JSON despite instructions), then
348	  # validate as a JSON object; returns a temp file path or nil.
349	  defp parse(nil), do: nil
350	
351	  defp parse(text) do
352	    cleaned =
353	      text
354	      |> String.split("\n")
355	      |> Enum.reject(&Regex.match?(~r/^\s*```/, &1))
356	      |> Enum.join("\n")
357	
358	    file = IJS.Util.tmp("classify-json")
359	    File.write!(file, cleaned)
360	
361	    if IJS.JQ.valid?(file) && IJS.JQ.raw(file, "if type==\"object\" then \"y\" else empty end"),
362	      do: file,
363	      else: nil
364	  end
365	end

367	defmodule IJS.Ask do
368	  import IJS.Util
369	
370	  def main(argv) do
371	    need!("jq")
372	    File.dir?("exchanges") && File.dir?("docs") || die("run from the itsjustshell2 repo root")
373	
374	    {name, prompt} =
375	      case argv do
376	        [n | rest] when rest != [] -> {n, Enum.join(rest, " ")}
377	        _ -> die("usage: elixir tools/ask.exs <slug> \"<prompt>\"")
378	      end
379	
380	    file_name =
381	      if String.ends_with?(name, ".md"),
382	        do: name,
383	        else: Date.to_iso8601(Date.utc_today()) <> "-" <> name <> ".md"
384	
385	    Regex.match?(~r/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-.+\.md$/, file_name) ||
386	      die("name must be a slug or YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md (got: #{file_name})")
387	
388	    target = "exchanges/" <> file_name
389	    sidecar = "exchanges/envelopes/" <> String.replace_suffix(file_name, ".md", ".json")
390	    File.exists?(target) && die("refusing to overwrite #{target} — exchanges are immutable")
391	
392	    # ---- call 1: the exchange itself ------------------------------------
393	    opts = %{stub: System.get_env("ASK_STUB"), model: System.get_env("ASK_MODEL")}
394	
395	    env =
396	      case IJS.Backend.ask(prompt, opts) do
397	        {:ok, e} -> e
398	        {:error, why} -> die(why)
399	      end
400	
401	    IJS.JQ.valid?(env) || die("backend output is not JSON (envelope: #{env})")
402	    h = IJS.Envelope.harvest(env)
403	    h.is_error == "true" && die("backend returned an error result — nothing filed (envelope: #{env})")
404	    h.result || die("empty result (envelope: #{env})")
405	
406	    date = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second) |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
407	
408	    # ---- retrieval (deterministic) + classification (proposal) ----------
409	    k = String.to_integer(System.get_env("ASK_K") || "4")
410	    candidates = IJS.Ledger.files(target)
411	    {top, all_scored} = IJS.Retriever.rank(prompt <> " " <> h.result, candidates, k)
412	
413	    vocab = IJS.Classifier.vocab()
414	    cprompt = IJS.Classifier.build_prompt(prompt, h.result, vocab, top, all_scored, target)
415	    c = IJS.Classifier.run(cprompt, vocab, target)
416	
417	    tags_value = if c.unusable, do: "UNCLASSIFIED", else: Enum.join(c.tags, ", ")
418	
419	    # ---- shown-list: no silent caps (docs/tripwires.md T3) ---------------
420	    shown_path = tmp("shown")
421	
422	    shown_lines =
423	      ["retriever k=#{k}; full-text shown: #{length(top)} of #{length(candidates)} candidates"] ++
424	        Enum.map(top, fn {f, s} -> "full: #{f} (score #{s})" end) ++
425	        Enum.map(all_scored -- top, fn {f, s} -> "stub: #{f} (score #{s})" end)
426	
427	    File.write!(shown_path, Enum.join(shown_lines, "\n") <> "\n")
428	
429	    # ---- side effects: a #derived projection of the sidecar -------------
430	    digest =
431	      "harness digest: num_turns=#{h.num_turns || "?"}, tools=#{if h.tools in [nil, ""], do: "none", else: h.tools}, permission_denials=#{h.denials || "0"}"
432	
433	    classifier_note =
434	      "tags and deps machine-proposed (classifier model: #{c.cmodel || "unreported"}" <>
435	        if(c.cost, do: ", cost_usd: #{c.cost}", else: "") <>
436	        ")" <> if(c.reason, do: " — reason: #{c.reason}", else: "")
437	
438	    side_effects =
439	      ["created persistent record (this document)", digest, classifier_note] ++
440	        ["retriever: full text shown for #{length(top)} of #{length(candidates)} candidates (shown_list in sidecar)"] ++
441	        if(c.new_tags != [], do: ["NEW tag not yet in taxonomy: #{Enum.join(c.new_tags, ", ")} — audit before commit"], else: []) ++
442	        if(c.dropped != [], do: ["classifier proposed invalid deps (dropped): #{Enum.join(c.dropped, ", ")}"], else: []) ++
443	        if(c.unusable, do: ["classifier output unusable — tags left UNCLASSIFIED; set by hand before commit"], else: [])
444	
445	    # ---- write the exchange + sidecar ------------------------------------
446	    content = """
447	    ---
448	    session_id: #{h.session_id || ""}
449	    date: #{date}
450	    model: #{h.model || ""}
451	    cost_usd: #{h.cost || ""}
452	    cwd: #{h.cwd || File.cwd!()}
453	    role: respondent
454	    tags: #{tags_value}
455	    deps: #{Enum.join(c.deps, ", ")}
456	    ---
457	
458	    ## Prompt
459	    #human-authored
460	
461	    #{prompt}
462	
463	    ## Response
464	    #agent-authored
465	
466	    #{h.result}
467	
468	    ## Side Effects
469	    #derived
470	
471	    #{Enum.join(side_effects, "\n")}
472	    """
473	
474	    File.mkdir_p!("exchanges/envelopes")
475	    File.write!(target, content)
476	    IJS.JQ.build_sidecar(env, c.env, shown_path, sidecar)
477	
478	    # Derived views are NOT refreshed here: branches carry records only;
479	    # the derivation job regenerates views on main after the cycle merges
480	    # (docs/workflow.md).
481	    IO.puts("wrote #{target}")
482	    IO.puts("      #{sidecar}")
483	    IO.puts("  tags: #{tags_value}#{if c.new_tags != [], do: " (NEW)", else: ""} | deps: #{if c.deps == [], do: "<blank>", else: Enum.join(c.deps, ", ")}")
484	    IO.puts("  answer cost_usd: #{h.cost || "?"}")
485	    IO.puts("review the file, then commit it to your open cycle branch:")
486	    IO.puts("  git add exchanges && git commit")
487	  end
488	end
489	
490	IJS.Ask.main(System.argv())

# tools/ask.exs — the capture pipeline.
#
#   elixir tools/ask.exs <slug|YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md> "<prompt>"
#
# One operator action in, one schema-complete exchange out, plus its
# sidecar. Division of labor per docs/exchange-schema.md: envelope fields
# are machine-harvested (never model-written); tags/deps are model-
# proposed and tool-validated; bodies are verbatim; the operator reads
# the file (the audit) and commits (the ratification). This tool never
# runs git.
#
# Env knobs:
#   ASK_MODEL            model for the answer call (default: CLI default)
#   ASK_CLASSIFY_MODEL   model for the classifier call (default: haiku)
#   ASK_K                retriever top-k full-text candidates (default 4)
#   ASK_STUB             canned answer envelope file (skips live call 1)
#   ASK_STUB_CLASSIFY    canned classifier envelope file (skips call 2)
#
# T6 note (docs/tripwires.md): this file exceeds one screen deliberately.
# Capture is one job with one seam (the backend adapter); splitting the
# pipeline would put the schema's single writer in two places.
#
# #agent-authored — provenance: exchanges/2026-08-15-bootstrap-thread.md

defmodule IJS.Util do
  def die(msg) do
    IO.puts(:stderr, "ask: " <> msg)
    System.halt(1)
  end

  def tmp(tag) do
    Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "ijs-#{tag}-#{:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])}")
  end

  def need!(exe) do
    System.find_executable(exe) || die("required executable not found: #{exe}")
  end
end

defmodule IJS.JQ do
  import IJS.Util

  def valid?(file) do
    match?({_, 0}, System.cmd("jq", ["-e", ".", file], stderr_to_stdout: true))
  end

  # jq -r over a file; nil when jq fails or the value is empty/null.
  def raw(file, filter) do
    case System.cmd("jq", ["-r", filter, file], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {out, 0} ->
        case String.trim(out) do
          "" -> nil
          "null" -> nil
          s -> s
        end

      _ ->
        nil
    end
  end

  def lines(file, filter) do
    case raw(file, filter) do
      nil -> []
      s -> s |> String.split("\n") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1) |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    end
  end

  def build_sidecar(answer_env, classify_env, shown_path, out_path) do
    base = ["-n", "--slurpfile", "answer", answer_env, "--rawfile", "shown", shown_path]

    {args, prog} =
      if classify_env && valid?(classify_env) do
        {base ++ ["--slurpfile", "classify", classify_env],
         "{answer_envelope: $answer[0], classifier_envelope: $classify[0], shown_list: ($shown | split(\"\\n\") | map(select(length>0)))}"}
      else
        {base,
         "{answer_envelope: $answer[0], classifier_envelope: null, shown_list: ($shown | split(\"\\n\") | map(select(length>0)))}"}
      end

    case System.cmd("jq", args ++ [prog], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {out, 0} -> File.write!(out_path, out)
      {err, _} -> IJS.Util.die("sidecar assembly failed: #{String.slice(err, 0, 200)}")
    end
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Backend do
  # Backend contract (docs/backend-contract.md): (prompt, opts) -> raw
  # envelope on disk. No tools are ever enabled on the call. Adapter #1
  # is claude -p; the stub adapter reads a canned envelope from a file.
  import IJS.Util

  def ask(prompt, opts) do
    case opts[:stub] do
      nil -> claude_p(prompt, opts)
      stub_file -> stub(stub_file)
    end
  end

  defp stub(stub_file) do
    File.exists?(stub_file) || die("stub envelope not found: #{stub_file}")
    path = tmp("envelope")
    File.cp!(stub_file, path)
    {:ok, path}
  end

  defp claude_p(prompt, opts) do
    need!("claude")

    # Vendor-specific defaults live here, in the adapter: classifier
    # calls default to the cheap tier when no model is requested.
    model = opts[:model] || if opts[:role] == :classifier, do: "haiku", else: nil

    args =
      ["-p", "--output-format", "json", "--verbose"] ++
        case model do
          nil -> []
          m -> ["--model", m]
        end ++ [prompt]

    # claude exits nonzero on error results but still emits the envelope
    # on stdout; we inspect the envelope rather than the exit code.
    {out, _code} = System.cmd("claude", args, stderr_to_stdout: false)
    path = tmp("envelope")
    File.write!(path, out)
    if String.trim(out) == "", do: {:error, "backend produced no output"}, else: {:ok, path}
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Envelope do
  # Shape-proof harvest: `-p --output-format json` emits one object,
  # adding --verbose emits an array of messages; both normalize first.
  @norm "[if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end]"

  defp q(file, tail), do: IJS.JQ.raw(file, @norm <> " | " <> tail)

  def harvest(file) do
    %{
      result: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].result // empty"),
      is_error: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].is_error // false"),
      session_id:
        q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].session_id // empty") ||
          q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].session_id // empty"),
      model:
        q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].model // empty") ||
          q(file, "(map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].modelUsage // {}) | keys | .[0] // empty"),
      cwd: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"system\" and .subtype==\"init\"))[0].cwd // empty"),
      cost: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].total_cost_usd // empty"),
      num_turns: q(file, "map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].num_turns // empty"),
      denials: q(file, "(map(select(.type==\"result\"))[0].permission_denials // []) | length"),
      tools:
        q(
          file,
          "[.[] | select(.type==\"assistant\") | .message.content[]? | select(.type==\"tool_use\") | .name] | join(\", \")"
        )
    }
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Ledger do
  def files(exclude \\ nil) do
    Path.wildcard("exchanges/*.md")
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == exclude))
    |> Enum.sort()
  end

  def frontmatter_value(file, key) do
    file
    |> File.read!()
    |> String.split("\n")
    |> Enum.find_value(fn line ->
      case String.split(line, ":", parts: 2) do
        [^key, v] -> String.trim(v)
        _ -> nil
      end
    end)
  end

  def first_prompt_line(file) do
    lines = file |> File.read!() |> String.split("\n")
    idx = Enum.find_index(lines, &(&1 == "## Prompt"))

    if idx do
      lines
      |> Enum.drop(idx + 1)
      |> Enum.take_while(&(!String.starts_with?(&1, "## ")))
      |> Enum.find("", fn l ->
        t = String.trim(l)
        t != "" && !String.starts_with?(t, "#")
      end)
      |> String.trim()
    else
      ""
    end
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Retriever do
  @stop ~w(the a an and or but of to in on for with is are was were be been being it its this that these those as at by from into over under about you your i we they he she them his her our what which who whom how why when where do does did done not no yes if then else so than too very just can could should would may might must will shall have has had having there here also)

  def tokens(text) do
    text
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9\s-]/, " ")
    |> String.split()
    |> Enum.reject(&(String.length(&1) < 3 || &1 in @stop))
    |> MapSet.new()
  end

  # Deterministic pre-sort: shared-token count, ties by recency (name desc).
  def rank(query_text, candidate_files, k) do
    q = tokens(query_text)

    scored =
      candidate_files
      |> Enum.map(fn f -> {f, MapSet.size(MapSet.intersection(q, tokens(File.read!(f))))} end)

    top =
      scored
      |> Enum.filter(fn {_, s} -> s > 0 end)
      |> Enum.sort_by(fn {f, s} -> {-s, f} end)
      |> Enum.take(k)

    {top, scored}
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Classifier do
  def vocab do
    tax =
      Path.wildcard("taxonomy/**")
      |> Enum.filter(&File.dir?/1)
      |> Enum.map(&String.replace_prefix(&1, "taxonomy/", ""))
      |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == "taxonomy"))

    used =
      IJS.Ledger.files()
      |> Enum.flat_map(fn f ->
        case IJS.Ledger.frontmatter_value(f, "tags") do
          nil -> []
          v -> v |> String.split(",") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
        end
      end)

    (tax ++ used) |> Enum.reject(&(&1 in ["", "UNCLASSIFIED"])) |> Enum.uniq() |> Enum.sort()
  end

  def build_prompt(question, answer, vocab, top, all_scored, target) do
    stub_lines =
      all_scored
      |> Enum.map(fn {f, _} ->
        "#{f} | tags: #{IJS.Ledger.frontmatter_value(f, "tags") || "none"} | prompt: #{IJS.Ledger.first_prompt_line(f)}"
      end)

    full_texts =
      top
      |> Enum.map(fn {f, score} ->
        "----- CANDIDATE (full text, score #{score}): #{f} -----\n" <>
          String.slice(File.read!(f), 0, 3000)
      end)

    """
    You are the classification step of an exchange-capture pipeline.
    Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no code fences, no prose:
    {"tags": ["<taxonomy path>", ...], "deps": ["<repo-relative path>", ...], "reason": "<one sentence>"}
    Rules:
    - tags: 1 to 3 entries. Prefer EXISTING TAGS verbatim; only if none fits, coin a new lowercase slash-path in the same style.
    - deps: zero or more paths chosen ONLY from the candidate exchanges listed below — prior exchanges the new one directly continues. Never invent a path. Never include #{target}.
    - reason: one sentence justifying both.

    EXISTING TAGS:
    #{Enum.join(vocab, "\n")}

    CANDIDATE EXCHANGES (every existing exchange, one line each):
    #{if stub_lines == [], do: "none", else: Enum.join(stub_lines, "\n")}

    TOP CANDIDATES (full text):
    #{if full_texts == [], do: "none", else: Enum.join(full_texts, "\n\n")}

    NEW EXCHANGE PROMPT:
    #{String.slice(question, 0, 600)}

    NEW EXCHANGE RESPONSE (may be truncated):
    #{String.slice(answer, 0, 2000)}
    """
  end

  # -> %{tags:, new_tags:, deps:, dropped:, reason:, cost:, env: path|nil, unusable: bool}
  def run(prompt, vocab, target) do
    opts = %{
      stub: System.get_env("ASK_STUB_CLASSIFY"),
      model: System.get_env("ASK_CLASSIFY_MODEL"),
      role: :classifier
    }

    empty = %{tags: [], new_tags: [], deps: [], dropped: [], reason: nil, cost: nil, cmodel: nil, env: nil, unusable: true}

    case IJS.Backend.ask(prompt, opts) do
      {:error, _} ->
        empty

      {:ok, env} ->
        h = IJS.Envelope.harvest(env)
        text = h.result
        cost = h.cost
        cmodel = h.model

        parsed = parse(text)

        case parsed do
          nil ->
            %{empty | cost: cost, cmodel: cmodel, env: env}

          file ->
            tags = IJS.JQ.lines(file, "(.tags // []) | if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end")
            deps = IJS.JQ.lines(file, "(.deps // []) | if type==\"array\" then .[] else . end")
            reason = IJS.JQ.raw(file, ".reason // empty")

            valid_tags =
              tags
              |> Enum.filter(&Regex.match?(~r{^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$}, &1))
              |> Enum.take(3)

            new_tags = Enum.reject(valid_tags, &(&1 in vocab))

            {kept, dropped} =
              Enum.split_with(deps, fn d ->
                String.starts_with?(d, "exchanges/") && File.exists?(d) && d != target
              end)

            %{
              tags: valid_tags,
              new_tags: new_tags,
              deps: kept,
              dropped: dropped,
              reason: reason,
              cost: cost,
              cmodel: cmodel,
              env: env,
              unusable: valid_tags == []
            }
        end
    end
  end

  # Strip fence lines (models fence JSON despite instructions), then
  # validate as a JSON object; returns a temp file path or nil.
  defp parse(nil), do: nil

  defp parse(text) do
    cleaned =
      text
      |> String.split("\n")
      |> Enum.reject(&Regex.match?(~r/^\s*```/, &1))
      |> Enum.join("\n")

    file = IJS.Util.tmp("classify-json")
    File.write!(file, cleaned)

    if IJS.JQ.valid?(file) && IJS.JQ.raw(file, "if type==\"object\" then \"y\" else empty end"),
      do: file,
      else: nil
  end
end

defmodule IJS.Ask do
  import IJS.Util

  def main(argv) do
    need!("jq")
    File.dir?("exchanges") && File.dir?("docs") || die("run from the itsjustshell2 repo root")

    {name, prompt} =
      case argv do
        [n | rest] when rest != [] -> {n, Enum.join(rest, " ")}
        _ -> die("usage: elixir tools/ask.exs <slug> \"<prompt>\"")
      end

    file_name =
      if String.ends_with?(name, ".md"),
        do: name,
        else: Date.to_iso8601(Date.utc_today()) <> "-" <> name <> ".md"

    Regex.match?(~r/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-.+\.md$/, file_name) ||
      die("name must be a slug or YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md (got: #{file_name})")

    target = "exchanges/" <> file_name
    sidecar = "exchanges/envelopes/" <> String.replace_suffix(file_name, ".md", ".json")
    File.exists?(target) && die("refusing to overwrite #{target} — exchanges are immutable")

    # ---- call 1: the exchange itself ------------------------------------
    opts = %{stub: System.get_env("ASK_STUB"), model: System.get_env("ASK_MODEL")}

    env =
      case IJS.Backend.ask(prompt, opts) do
        {:ok, e} -> e
        {:error, why} -> die(why)
      end

    IJS.JQ.valid?(env) || die("backend output is not JSON (envelope: #{env})")
    h = IJS.Envelope.harvest(env)
    h.is_error == "true" && die("backend returned an error result — nothing filed (envelope: #{env})")
    h.result || die("empty result (envelope: #{env})")

    date = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second) |> DateTime.to_iso8601()

    # ---- retrieval (deterministic) + classification (proposal) ----------
    k = String.to_integer(System.get_env("ASK_K") || "4")
    candidates = IJS.Ledger.files(target)
    {top, all_scored} = IJS.Retriever.rank(prompt <> " " <> h.result, candidates, k)

    vocab = IJS.Classifier.vocab()
    cprompt = IJS.Classifier.build_prompt(prompt, h.result, vocab, top, all_scored, target)
    c = IJS.Classifier.run(cprompt, vocab, target)

    tags_value = if c.unusable, do: "UNCLASSIFIED", else: Enum.join(c.tags, ", ")

    # ---- shown-list: no silent caps (docs/tripwires.md T3) ---------------
    shown_path = tmp("shown")

    shown_lines =
      ["retriever k=#{k}; full-text shown: #{length(top)} of #{length(candidates)} candidates"] ++
        Enum.map(top, fn {f, s} -> "full: #{f} (score #{s})" end) ++
        Enum.map(all_scored -- top, fn {f, s} -> "stub: #{f} (score #{s})" end)

    File.write!(shown_path, Enum.join(shown_lines, "\n") <> "\n")

    # ---- side effects: a #derived projection of the sidecar -------------
    digest =
      "harness digest: num_turns=#{h.num_turns || "?"}, tools=#{if h.tools in [nil, ""], do: "none", else: h.tools}, permission_denials=#{h.denials || "0"}"

    classifier_note =
      "tags and deps machine-proposed (classifier model: #{c.cmodel || "unreported"}" <>
        if(c.cost, do: ", cost_usd: #{c.cost}", else: "") <>
        ")" <> if(c.reason, do: " — reason: #{c.reason}", else: "")

    side_effects =
      ["created persistent record (this document)", digest, classifier_note] ++
        ["retriever: full text shown for #{length(top)} of #{length(candidates)} candidates (shown_list in sidecar)"] ++
        if(c.new_tags != [], do: ["NEW tag not yet in taxonomy: #{Enum.join(c.new_tags, ", ")} — audit before commit"], else: []) ++
        if(c.dropped != [], do: ["classifier proposed invalid deps (dropped): #{Enum.join(c.dropped, ", ")}"], else: []) ++
        if(c.unusable, do: ["classifier output unusable — tags left UNCLASSIFIED; set by hand before commit"], else: [])

    # ---- write the exchange + sidecar ------------------------------------
    content = """
    ---
    session_id: #{h.session_id || ""}
    date: #{date}
    model: #{h.model || ""}
    cost_usd: #{h.cost || ""}
    cwd: #{h.cwd || File.cwd!()}
    role: respondent
    tags: #{tags_value}
    deps: #{Enum.join(c.deps, ", ")}
    ---

    ## Prompt
    #human-authored

    #{prompt}

    ## Response
    #agent-authored

    #{h.result}

    ## Side Effects
    #derived

    #{Enum.join(side_effects, "\n")}
    """

    File.mkdir_p!("exchanges/envelopes")
    File.write!(target, content)
    IJS.JQ.build_sidecar(env, c.env, shown_path, sidecar)

    # Derived views are NOT refreshed here: branches carry records only;
    # the derivation job regenerates views on main after the cycle merges
    # (docs/workflow.md).
    IO.puts("wrote #{target}")
    IO.puts("      #{sidecar}")
    IO.puts("  tags: #{tags_value}#{if c.new_tags != [], do: " (NEW)", else: ""} | deps: #{if c.deps == [], do: "<blank>", else: Enum.join(c.deps, ", ")}")
    IO.puts("  answer cost_usd: #{h.cost || "?"}")
    IO.puts("review the file, then commit it to your open cycle branch:")
    IO.puts("  git add exchanges && git commit")
  end
end
